verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a Marketing Emails API that can create, update and retrieve marketing emails, individually or in batches, and pull post-send statistics. That is real first-party API coverage of part of the UI's email workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows parity with the much broader set of UI features: sending or scheduling, send speed, recipient segments and exclusions, workflows, social publishing, dashboards and the AI agents. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for sending/scheduling, segmentation, workflows, social, reporting and other UI-only features, any documented API-UI parity statement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
